mockReviews.title: Genuinely looks like real leather
mockReviews.body: Ordered the black jacket for Eid and it arrived in two days. The material is stiff for the first day, then it moulds to your shoulders and feels like real leather. Stitching around the zip and cuffs is clean, no loose threads anywhere. Worth the price.

mockReviews.title: Best jacket I own
mockReviews.body: I have bought three leather-look jackets over the last four years and this one is by far the best. The lining is not scratchy and the inner pocket is actually usable. It survives a full Dhaka commute in the humidity without peeling.

mockReviews.title: Soft leather, warm enough for October
mockReviews.body: Bought it for the two weeks of October when the evenings turn cool. The material is softer than I expected and it does not stick to the skin. Only note: the zip is a little stiff for the first few uses.

mockReviews.title: Nice jacket, size runs large
mockReviews.body: Quality is good and the colour is a proper black, not grey. I normally wear M and took S as advised in the size chart, but the shoulders are still slightly wide. Sizing down is the right call if you want a fitted look.

mockReviews.title: The cargo pockets are actually useful
mockReviews.body: Bought these for daily wear and they have held up to two months of washing. The six pockets are deep enough for a phone and keys without the whole leg sagging. Fabric is thick but not stiff.

mockReviews.title: Perfect for the winter
mockReviews.body: Wore it through a full January and I was fine without a heavy sweater underneath. The collar sits flat and does not flap in the wind, which was my main complaint with the last jacket I owned.

mockReviews.title: Good fit, slightly long
mockReviews.body: The baggy fit is exactly as advertised. For me they are an inch too long in the leg, so I got them tailored. Delivery was quick and the packaging was neat. Four stars only because of the length for shorter wearers.

mockReviews.title: Good, but the zip sticks
mockReviews.body: The jacket itself is solid and the leather finish has not cracked yet. The main zip however catches halfway sometimes and needs a second pull. Fixable, but it is annoying when you are in a hurry.

mockReviews.title: Good jacket, cuffs could be tighter
mockReviews.body: Everything is as described and the finish still looks new after a few wears. The one thing I would change is the wrist cuffs, which stay a little open on a slim wrist. Easy to leave the top button undone and it stops mattering.

mockReviews.title: Stylish, runs slim through the body
mockReviews.body: Looks great and the cut is flattering. I have a slightly fuller build and it pulls a little across the chest when I sit down. The seller swapped me to a larger size without any argument, which counts for a lot.

mockReviews.title: Second one I have bought
mockReviews.body: Bought the first one as a gift and liked it enough to order a second for myself. Same quality as the first delivery, no batch differences. The brand seems consistent, which is rare now.

mockReviews.title: Exactly what I wanted
mockReviews.body: Simple, sturdy and the right amount of room in the thigh. These replaced a pair of jeans for me in the office. I am usually between 32 and 34 and took 32, the fit is true.

mockReviews.title: Stands up to heavy use
mockReviews.body: I ride a motorbike and this has been rained on twice. It wiped clean with a dry cloth and the shoulders have not started flaking, unlike a cheaper jacket I bought last year that peeled in a month.

mockReviews.title: Finished beautifully
mockReviews.body: The seams are pressed flat and nothing is glued or stapled visibly, which is where cheaper jackets give themselves away. I have worn it for a month of office commutes and it still looks new.

mockReviews.title: Smell and finish
mockReviews.body: The jacket arrived with a strong chemical smell that took a week of airing to fade, and the finish is slightly shiny rather than matte. It is still wearable, but I expected a more premium surface for this price.

mockReviews.title: Solid everyday jacket
mockReviews.body: No complaints after three months. Buttons are solid metal and have not come loose. Only small thing is that the inside lining is a little thin, so it is not a jacket for the very cold days.

mockReviews.title: Sturdy, rides well on a bike
mockReviews.body: I wear these on the rickshaw commute every day. The reinforced knees have not gone soft, and the buttoned back pockets keep my phone from bouncing. They wash fine, though I air dry them rather than tumble dry.

mockReviews.title: Good fabric, odd waist
mockReviews.body: The material feels durable and the colour is true to the photos. The waistband sits higher than I expected and the belt loops are placed a little awkwardly. Not a dealbreaker but worth knowing.

mockReviews.title: Bought two more for my brothers
mockReviews.body: Ordered three in the end. The jacket keeps its shape, the black has not faded at all after multiple washes, and the delivery guy was polite about the swapping. Very happy with this purchase.

mockReviews.title: Nice finish, ordered the wrong size
mockReviews.body: The jacket is clearly good quality and I have no complaint about the material. I ordered L by mistake out of habit, and swapping to M was done without any hassle in three days, so the seller handled it well.

mockReviews.title: Not for me
mockReviews.body: The shoulders were far too wide on me and the length stopped above the hip, so it looked like a cropped jacket. The quality is fine, it simply does not suit my body shape and the size chart was not much help.

mockReviews.title: Exactly as pictured
mockReviews.body: The photos do not oversell it. Same black, same cut, same finish. Sleeves have the right length with a small tab to shorten them if needed, which I used.

mockReviews.title: Warm and lightweight
mockReviews.body: Surprisingly warm for something that looks so thin. I have worn it on cool evenings and windy mornings and it blocks the wind well. The only thing I would change is adding another inside pocket.

mockReviews.title: Great value
mockReviews.body: I compared three similar jackets in this range and this one has the best stitching by a clear margin. Delivery took four days to Chattogram, packaging was proper and there was no damage.

mockReviews.title: Second review, still happy
mockReviews.body: Came back to leave a note after six months of wear. No cracking on the elbows, no loose threads, zip still smooth. This jacket has held up better than anything else I own from the same price bracket.
